likely_causes.cause: Local collector or Mosquitto not running
Ingest secret or cloud URL mismatch

homeowner_checks: Confirm the sensor node has USB power and joins Wi-Fi
Confirm the collector process is running next to Mosquitto
Do not use an old number as current — Stale means unknown
Check Live tiles: missing or stale after two minutes is expected when silent
tech_only: Probe wiring repair at line voltage adjacent equipment
Opening the furnace for probe placement (power off, meter verify)
call_pro_when: Hardware probes are installed on the live unit and stay stale after power/Wi-Fi checks — a tech may need wiring work with power off.
sources: docs/PLAN.md stale sensor / node offline rules
assumptions: Age uses cloud received_at, not the node clock
